paper_trade._comment_queue: Queue ahead advances on trades at our price and, proportionally to our place in the level, on the rest of the level's size reduction (cancels): ~3/4 of KORUUSDT touch-size reductions were cancels. Orders and cancels take 5 ms to reach the venue (host RTT to Binance ~4 ms plus matching), during which public trades can still fill a quote being cancelled.
paper_trade._comment_fees: Post-only (GTX) and RPI maker fills cost 0; IOC/market taker fills cost 0.025% (2.5 bps).
